subject: GLPI first bring-up COMPLETE and green: three gaps fixed (proof unregistered, image doesn't auto-install, REST API off) + a live-glpi sim op added
body:
GLPI first bring-up is COMPLETE and green — proof:live-glpi 3/3, capture minted at artifacts/live-captures/glpi.json. Like Headwind, the first real run surfaced gaps that were never exercised before; three fixed, all verified live on glpi/glpi:11.0.8.

1. proof:live-glpi WAS NOT REGISTERED. scripts/package.json had it, but the ROOT package.json (which run-live-lanes runs against) did not — so the lane died with "Missing script: proof:live-glpi" before touching the container. Added the root delegator next to the other proof:live-* entries.

2. THE IMAGE DOES NOT AUTO-INSTALL. glpi/glpi:11.0.8 with GLPI_DB_* set serves its SETUP WIZARD on first boot — config_db.php is never written, the DB stays at 0 tables, and every REST path returns the wizard HTML: a 200 that is the installer, not the API. Your wait_http on / was satisfied by that wizard, so the lane thought GLPI was up when it was not installed at all. Fix, baked into the lane after wait_http: `php bin/console database:install --db-host=sg-glpi-db --db-name=glpi --db-user=glpi --db-password=glpi --no-interaction --reconfigure --force` (with a mariadb-readiness wait first). Fresh containers every run, so --force never double-installs.

3. THE REST API IS OFF BY DEFAULT, and the seeded client is localhost-only. After install, /apirest.php/initSession returned ["ERROR","API disabled"] (enable_api=0). Enabling it exposed the next layer: ERROR_NOT_ALLOWED_IP, because the one seeded apiclient ("full access from localhost") is pinned to 127.0.0.1 and the caller arrives as the container-gateway IP. Fix, baked in: UPDATE glpi_configs SET value='1' for enable_api and enable_api_login_credentials; widen apiclient id=1 ipv4 range to all; cache:clear. Verified: after these steps a glpi/glpi initSession returns a real session_token (200).

WHAT THE CAPTURE NOW RECORDS (contract-ready shapes, all real):
  /                          200 html  "Authentication - GLPI" (installed, past the wizard)
  /apirest.php               200 html  "API Documentation - GLPI"
  /apirest.php/initSession   400 json  ["ERROR_LOGIN_PARAMETERS_MISSING", ...]   <- v1 surface exists, wants creds
  /api.php                   403 json  {"status":"ERROR_RIGHT_MISSING","detail":"The High-Level API is disabled"}
So BOTH surfaces exist: v1 (/apirest.php) is live and credential-gated; v2 (/api.php, the High-Level API) exists but is separately disabled (enable_hlapi=0). I left HLAPI OFF on purpose — that "disabled" is honest discovery, not a defect. If you want the NEXT proof to assert a v2 contract, enabling enable_hlapi is the one extra step; say the word and I'll add it to the lane.

SIM OPERATION. There was no live-glpi sim-operation, so this request had to bind live-lanes (ALL vendors), which cannot close on a single Mac pass. I added scripts/lib/sim-operations.mjs live-glpi (--only glpi) and re-pointed the request to it; it now closes on exactly this vendor. All of the above is committed and pushed.
